title: Food support close to home
summaryZh: 英格兰45个地方政府将获资助，因地制宜改善居民获得健康、可负担食物的机会。
levelReason: 编辑估计A2：具体社区服务与短句为主，使用because、may和will说明理由与计划；deprivation等少量较难词有中文释义。

sentences.text: Some families find it difficult to buy healthy food at prices they can afford.
sentences.zh: 一些家庭发现，很难以负担得起的价格购买健康食物。

sentences.text: On 30 September 2026, the UK government announced almost £10 million for a new food programme in England.
sentences.zh: 2026年9月30日，英国政府宣布将向英格兰一项新的食物计划提供近1,000万英镑。

sentences.text: The money will go to 45 local authorities, and each local authority will receive £222,000.
sentences.zh: 这笔资金将分配给45个地方政府，每个将获得222,000英镑。

sentences.text: These areas were chosen because many people face deprivation, or lack basic resources, and childhood obesity is high.
sentences.zh: 选择这些地区是因为许多人面临贫困、缺乏基本资源，而且儿童肥胖程度较高。

sentences.text: Local leaders will decide how to use the support to meet the needs of their communities.
sentences.zh: 地方领导者将决定如何使用这些支持，以满足所在社区的需要。

sentences.text: They could support food shops in the community or sellers who bring fresh vegetables to different places.
sentences.zh: 他们可以支持社区食物商店，或把新鲜蔬菜送到不同地方销售的商贩。

sentences.text: Other possible activities include lunch clubs, community kitchens and cooking lessons.
sentences.zh: 其他可能开展的活动包括午餐俱乐部、社区厨房和烹饪课程。

sentences.text: These are only examples, and different areas may offer different activities.
sentences.zh: 这些只是例子，不同地区可能会提供不同的活动。

sentences.text: The programme will also work with businesses and charities to build on projects that already exist.
sentences.zh: 该计划还将与企业和慈善机构合作，在现有项目的基础上继续开展工作。

sentences.text: The aim is to help more people get healthy, affordable food close to where they live.
sentences.zh: 目标是帮助更多人在居住地附近获得健康、价格可负担的食物。

sentences.note: may表示可能性，说明列举的服务只是选项，不代表各地都会开展相同活动。

questions.text: Which would help your neighbourhood more: a community kitchen or a mobile vegetable seller? Why?
questions.zh: 社区厨房和流动蔬菜商贩，哪一种对你所在社区帮助更大？为什么？

expressions.zh: 在我所在的社区，我们需要……
expressions.note: 教学补充表达，不是新闻引语。
